# The Money Converter

> > Real-time currency converter and foreign exchange rate information for 90 world currencies with live forex data and historical charts.

The Money Converter provides instant currency conversion and exchange rate lookups across major and minor world currencies. The platform offers live forex rates, 120-day historical charts, and comprehensive currency reference data for international money exchanges.

## Core Currency Converter

- [Currency Converter and Exchange Rate Information](https://themoneyconverter.com): Homepage with currency converter and live exchange rates for 90 world currencies.
